messages:
maya: Morning async — quick standup for API edge (routing / auth / rate limits).

What I did: cut over the new prefix-based route matcher in staging and ran the smoke suite.
Blockers: seeing intermittent 429s in the canary when burst traffic hits cached prefixes — kv-cache TTL might be the culprit.
Today: triage 429s, add extra logging, deploy a narrow canary with soft-429 policy, and review CR #4321.

zheng: Nice. Do the 429s show up on Dedicated or only Hosted staging? I saw a similar pattern last month tied to cache eviction during heavy prefix churn.

sam: I can add runtime logging hooks for batching + kv cache hits. Ping me and I’ll attach a small flame graph for the spike windows. @arjun fyi for kernel counters.

olivia: Heads up — I’ll rotate the oauth client for gw-forms at ~11:30 UTC. Expect short 401s for a minute while clients re-auth. I’ll post deploy-bot notice before start. :warning:

arjun: On kernel telemetry — I can wire counters for kernel selection and KV hit/miss paths. If we see misrouted requests we can correlate with kernel switches. Maya, can you paste a sample log?

maya: sure — sample routing log (staging):
```
[edge-router] INFO prefix_match="/api/v1/" route_id=route-12 conf_matcher=prefix-v2 cache_hit=true kv_ttl=120ms latency_ms=3
[edge-runtime] WARN request_id=abcd1234 status=429 reason="burst_throttle" batch_size=8
```

deploy-bot: deploy started: oauth-rotate-gw-forms at 2026-03-17T11:30:00Z (eta ≈ 2m).

sam: For the canary 429s, consider using a soft-429 policy with `Retry-After` so clients back off instead of failing over to fallback models. Example config snippet:
```
rate_policy:
  mode: soft
  window_ms: 1000
  max_tokens_per_window: 5000
  retry_after_secs: 1
```

maya: good idea. I’ll try that on the narrow canary (10% traffic) after we add the extra logs. Also CR #4321 (api-edge-prefilter) is small — updates the matcher order and adds a unit test. @zheng @sam can you review?

zheng: I’ll take a look right after this. Quick Q: where’s the kv-cache TTL configured? I thought it lived in `edge/runtime/cache_config` but can’t find the override for staging.

maya: correct path is `edge/runtime/cache_config.yaml`. Staging override lives at `infra/staging/edge-vars.yaml` — TTL currently 120ms, can bump to 500ms for canary.

olivia: :thumbsup: I’ll add a note in #incidents in case the oauth rotation causes a spike. Also I’m pushing a small replay harness that can flood staging at controlled RPS for repro.

arjun: I’ll wire the kernel counters and add an env var `EDGE_KV_STRICT=false` we can flip if we detect corruption. If logs show kv_ttl expiries + batch reorders that’s the smoking gun.

maya: plan summary: 1) add logs + kernel counters, 2) run replay harness on staging, 3) roll 10% canary with soft-429 and bumped TTL, 4) review CR #4321. Ping here for access. (reacted :eyes: by arjun)

sam: sounds good. I’ll queue the logging change and notify once instrumentation is up.

zheng: reviewing CR now.

olivia: I’ll post when oauth rotation starts/completes.

maya: thanks all — async check-in complete.
